Title: Generally available: Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL REST APIs

Body.Content:
Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs are service endpoints that support sets of HTTP operations (methods), which provide create, retrieve, update, or delete access to the Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL clusters. You can now use REST APIs to perform programmatically all cluster management operations such as cluster create, Postgres server parameter change, or firewall rule delete. Management REST APIs allows you to significantly decrease overhead for repetitive actions such as setting up a dev/test environment.

Learn More
